criteria.reason: The complete briefing retains the Thursday decision context, current-team continuity, counts and evidence limits, collection-size distinction, consent/switch-back, timeout threshold and preceding-day interval, approval, opt-in behavior and later review. Shorter phrasing does not change those relationships.

The reader can decide on four further invitations and follow prerequisites and postponement using the same evidence. The title supplies Thursday context for the later approval step, and the final paragraph keeps expansion and default-setting decisions separate.

A direct opening, two connected evidence paragraphs and invitation-condition bullets keep the decision and actions easy to locate. The short follow-up paragraph supplies the remaining boundary without a redundant closing recap or unnecessary section.
